description: The engine's repository on its forge: the one the service's looks (canary, checks, pre-gate, prewarm, observations, branches, full run, merge-ready) read and judge. The service reads it live from the port (PUT /v1/config/service.engine_repo); TOWER_ENGINE_REPO in the service's environment wins over it. A value that is not owner/name is refused by the port and ignored by the reader.
x-source: Torre 14/11 (GitHub migration): the repository identity comes from configuration
